module: Draws the roads of the navigation graph (map.getMap()) on the minimap. On the first call, it builds an array of segments (positions, color according to drivability) and a 2D kd-tree (kdtreebox2d); on later calls it queries the kd-tree around the camera and draws the visible segments with td:lineRoundEndWithBackground on the ROADS_BG/ROADS_FG layers. Utility module of the minimap, loaded by require, not an extension to call directly.
notes: The first call of drawRoads draws nothing: it only builds the cache; drawing starts at the second call.
Color according to link.drivability: >= 0.9 normal color, > 0.25 colorLow, otherwise colorLowest. hiddenInNavi links are ignored.
If there are no roads and the grid is not already enabled (debugSettings.drawGrid), it calls ui_apps_minimap_utils.drawGrid if it exists.
Call reset() when the navigation map changes, otherwise the cache stays stale.

drawRoads.desc: Builds the roads cache on the first call, then draws the roads visible in the square of side 2*radius centered on the camera.

radius.desc: Half-side of the queried area, in world meters.

debugSettings.desc: Debug settings; only drawGrid is read.

scale.desc: Map scale; the line width is 2 / scale * dpi.

reset.desc: Clears the cache (kd-tree and hasRoads flag); it will be rebuilt at the next drawRoads.
